title: Channels
savedPending: Saved settings differ from runtime; start or restart this channel to apply them
stopHint: Stop this channel immediately, even if the saved configuration is invalid. Service restart still follows startup settings.
managedEnabled: Enabled setting is managed by environment variables or startup arguments; you can still stop this channel temporarily

delivery.title: Delivery recovery
delivery.description: Confirmed parts will not be sent again. Check the destination chat before recovering an uncertain delivery.
delivery.retryTitle: Confirm the remaining content was not delivered
delivery.retryWarning: Check the destination chat first. Confirmed parts will be skipped. Continue only after verifying that the uncertain parts were not delivered, to avoid duplicates.
delivery.confirmTitle: Record the entire message as delivered
delivery.confirmWarning: Confirm that the recipient received the entire message and all attachments. Recording this outcome stops further retries.
delivery.unknown: Some delivery results are uncertain and need verification.
delivery.unsent: Some content was not delivered. Continue after the confirmed parts.
delivery.viewFull: View the full message and attachment names
delivery.sendMessage: Restore the Weixin conversation by sending this bot a message in Weixin.
delivery.relogin: Your Weixin login expired. Scan the login QR code again, then send the bot a message.
delivery.autoRetry: Saved scheduled results will resume automatically after a new message. Confirmed parts are skipped.
delivery.waitingContext: Report saved; waiting for delivery to resume.

deliveryHealth.ready: Conversation context saved; delivery still depends on Weixin acceptance
deliveryHealth.no_context: Listening; send this bot a message to establish a delivery conversation
deliveryHealth.needs_message: Weixin rejected a conversation; send the bot a message to resume saved results
deliveryHealth.login_required: Weixin login expired; scan the login QR code again
